Show all pairs of entertainers and customers who each have up to three style strengths or preferences, where the first and second style preferences of the customers match the first and second style strengths of the entertainers (or in reverse order). Only return the entertainer’s stage name and the customer’s last name

WITH ranked_ent AS (
    SELECT EntertainerID, StyleID,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EntertainerID ORDER BY StyleID) as rn
    FROM Entertainer_Styles
    WHERE EntertainerID IN (SELECT EntertainerID FROM Entertainer_Styles GROUP BY EntertainerID HAVING COUNT(*) <= 3)
),
ent_first AS (SELECT EntertainerID, StyleID as FirstStyleID FROM ranked_ent WHERE rn = 1),
ent_second AS (SELECT EntertainerID, StyleID as SecondStyleID FROM ranked_ent WHERE rn = 2),
ent_pairs AS (
    SELECT e1.EntertainerID, e1.FirstStyleID, COALESCE(e2.SecondStyleID, -1) as SecondStyleID
    FROM ent_first e1
    LEFT JOIN ent_second e2 ON e1.EntertainerID = e2.EntertainerID
),
ranked_cust AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, StyleID,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY PreferenceSeq) as rn
    FROM Musical_Preferences
    WHERE CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM Musical_Preferences GROUP BY CustomerID HAVING COUNT(*) <= 3)
),
cust_first AS (SELECT CustomerID, StyleID as FirstPrefStyleID FROM ranked_cust WHERE rn = 1),
cust_second AS (SELECT CustomerID, StyleID as SecondPrefStyleID FROM ranked_cust WHERE rn = 2),
cust_pairs AS (
    SELECT c1.CustomerID, c1.FirstPrefStyleID, COALESCE(c2.SecondPrefStyleID, -1) as SecondPrefStyleID
    FROM cust_first c1
    LEFT JOIN cust_second c2 ON c1.CustomerID = c2.CustomerID
)
SELECT ep.EntertainerID, ep.FirstStyleID, ep.SecondStyleID,
       cp.CustomerID, cp.FirstPrefStyleID, cp.SecondPrefStyleID
FROM ent_pairs ep
JOIN cust_pairs

WITH entertainer_first_two AS (
    SELECT EntertainerID, StyleID,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EntertainerID ORDER BY StyleID) as rn
    FROM Entertainer_Styles
    WHERE EntertainerID IN (SELECT EntertainerID FROM Entertainer_Styles GROUP BY EntertainerID HAVING COUNT(*) <= 3)
),
customer_first_two AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, StyleID,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY PreferenceSeq) as rn
    FROM Musical_Preferences
    WHERE CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM Musical_Preferences GROUP BY CustomerID HAVING COUNT(*) <= 3)
),
matching_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        e.EntertainerID,
        e.StyleID as ent_style1,
        e1.StyleID as ent_style2,
        c.CustomerID,
        c.StyleID as cust_pref1,
        c1.StyleID as cust_pref2
    FROM entertainer_first_two e
    JOIN entertainer_first_two e1 ON e.EntertainerID = e1.EntertainerID AND e.rn < e1.rn
    JOIN customer_first_two c ON c.rn = 1
    JOIN customer_first_two c1 ON c.CustomerID = c1.CustomerID AND c.rn < c1.rn
    WHERE (e.StyleID = c.StyleID AND e1.StyleID = c1.StyleID)
       OR (e.StyleID = c1.StyleID AND e1.StyleID = c.StyleID)
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    E.EntStageName,
    C.CustLastName
FROM matching_pairs mp
JOIN Entertainers E ON mp.EntertainerID = E.EntertainerID
JOIN Customers C ON mp.CustomerID = C.CustomerID

WITH ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        StyleID,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY PreferenceSeq) as rn
    FROM Musical_Preferences
),
customer_first_second AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN StyleID END) as first_pref,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN StyleID END) as second_pref,
        COUNT(*) as pref_count
    FROM ranked_customers
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 2 AND 3
),
ranked_entertainers AS (
    SELECT 
        EntertainerID,
        StyleID,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EntertainerID ORDER BY StyleStrength DESC) as rn
    FROM Entertainer_Styles
),
entertainer_first_second AS (
    SELECT 
        EntertainerID,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN StyleID END) as first_strong,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN StyleID END) as second_strong,
        COUNT(*) as strength_count
    FROM ranked_entertainers
    GROUP BY EntertainerID
    HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 2 AND 3
)
SELECT 
    ent.EntStageName,
    cu_tab.CustLastName
FROM entertainer_first_second efs
JOIN Entertainers ent ON efs.EntertainerID = ent.EntertainerID
JOIN customer_first_second cfs ON (
    (cfs.first_pref = efs.first_strong AND cfs.second_pref = efs.second_strong)
    OR (cfs.first_pref = efs.second_strong AND cfs.second_pref = efs.first_strong)
)
JOIN Customers cu_tab ON cfs.CustomerID = cu_tab.CustomerID
